title: RM-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Generative Reward Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.20174v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning on Mixed-domain preference data (Mix-RL) has become the mainstream approach for training general-purpose Generative Reward Models (GRMs). However, Mix-RL suffers from two critical bottlenecks: the reward sparsity induced by outcome rewards, and the cross-domain interference arising from jointly optimizing heterogeneous capabilities, which together give rise to imbalanced capability acquisition and pervasive reward hacking. translated_title: RM-OPD：面向生成式奖励模型的同策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 基于混合领域偏好数据的强化学习（Mix-RL）已成为训练通用生成式奖励模型（GRM）的主流方法。然而，Mix-RL 存在两个关键瓶颈：由结果奖励导致的奖励稀疏性，以及联合优化异构能力所引起的跨领域干扰，二者共同导致了能力获取不均衡和普遍的奖励欺骗问题。受同策略蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation, OPD）在多领域能力融合中成功应用的启发，我们提出了 RM-OPD（通过同策略蒸馏进行奖励建模），这是一个将专家能力获取与能力整合相分离的两阶段框架。首先，我们通过单领域 GRPO 微调培养领域专精的教师模型，使每个专家能够在隔离状态下达到其性能上限；然后，我们通过路由同策略蒸馏将这些教师模型整合到一个学生模型中。
tldr: 该论文提出RM-OPD两阶段框架，先通过单领域GRPO微调训练各领域专家教师模型，再通过路由同策略蒸馏将其整合为单一学生模型，从而解决Mix-RL训练生成式奖励模型时的奖励稀疏与跨领域干扰问题。
en_tdlr: RM-OPD is a two-stage framework that first trains domain-specialized teacher models via single-domain GRPO fine-tuning and then consolidates them into a single student model through routed on-policy distillation, addressing reward sparsity and cross-domain interference in Mix-RL-based generative reward model training.
